zh-Hans.name: 放大与超分
zh-Hans.description: 改变图像尺寸，按素材选择通用缩放、动画线条重建、像素画放大或时序超分。

subcategories.name: 通用
subcategories.description: 缩放照片、视频、游戏和界面。Bilinear 偏柔和且开销低，Bicubic 可调平滑度与锐度，Lanczos 偏锐利。

subcategories.name: 动画线条
subcategories.description: 重建动画与视觉小说的轮廓和色块；带噪声素材可选降噪模型，固定倍率按目标尺寸选择。

subcategories.name: 像素画
subcategories.description: 最近邻保留像素块，xBR／xBRZ 平滑轮廓。整数倍率保持均匀网格，自由尺寸方案用于适配窗口或屏幕。

subcategories.name: 时序重建
subcategories.description: 结合连续捕获帧重建细节，适合游戏与视频放大。运动由图像估计，快速运动、遮挡和界面边缘可能出现重影。

subcategories.name: 缩小与尺寸整理
subcategories.description: 降低图像分辨率，或将固定倍率放大后的画面整理到最终输出尺寸。

en-US.name: Upscaling and super resolution
en-US.description: Resize images with general resampling, anime outline reconstruction, pixel-art scaling, or temporal upscaling.

subcategories.name: General purpose
subcategories.description: Resize photos, video, games, and interfaces. Bilinear is soft and inexpensive, Bicubic offers adjustable smoothness and sharpness, and Lanczos favors sharp edges.

subcategories.name: Anime and line art
subcategories.description: Reconstruct outlines and flat colors in anime and visual novels. Choose denoising models for noisy content and a fixed scale that suits the target size.

subcategories.name: Pixel art
subcategories.description: Nearest preserves pixel blocks; xBR/xBRZ smooth outlines. Integer scales keep an even grid; flexible-size methods fit a window or display.

subcategories.name: Temporal reconstruction
subcategories.description: Reconstruct detail from consecutive captured frames for games and video. Motion is estimated from images; fast motion, occlusion, and UI edges can produce ghosting.

subcategories.name: Downscaling and resizing
subcategories.description: Reduce image resolution or fit a fixed-scale upscaled image to the final output size.

zh-Hans.name: 清理修复
zh-Hans.description: 减轻噪声、色带或线条缺陷，通常先清理素材，再放大与锐化。

subcategories.name: 降噪
subcategories.description: 减轻颗粒和压缩噪声。从较低强度开始，随噪声程度增加；较强处理也会平滑细小纹理。

subcategories.name: 去色带
subcategories.description: 柔化天空和暗部渐变的分层边界，用阈值与范围控制处理程度。

subcategories.name: 线条修复
subcategories.description: 恢复动画轮廓或调整粗细，通常用于放大前的线条整理。

en-US.name: Cleanup and restoration
en-US.description: Reduce noise, banding, or line defects, usually before upscaling and sharpening.

subcategories.name: Denoising
subcategories.description: Reduce grain and compression noise. Start with low strength and increase for noisier content; stronger processing also smooths fine texture.

subcategories.name: Debanding
subcategories.description: Soften stepped gradients in skies and shadows; use threshold and range to control the amount.

subcategories.name: Line restoration
subcategories.description: Restore anime outlines or adjust line thickness, usually before upscaling.

zh-Hans.name: 抗锯齿
zh-Hans.description: 平滑阶梯状边缘；空间方案处理当前帧，时序方案结合连续帧。

subcategories.name: 空间
subcategories.description: 直接平滑当前画面的轮廓，适合先尝试的游戏抗锯齿。处理同时会柔化部分文字与细线。

subcategories.name: 时序
subcategories.description: 结合帧历史处理细线与斜边；属于实验方案，运动边缘可能产生重影。

en-US.name: Anti-aliasing
en-US.description: Smooth stair-step edges using the current frame or consecutive frames.

subcategories.name: Spatial
subcategories.description: Smooth outlines in the current image as a starting point for game anti-aliasing. Processing also softens some text and thin lines.

subcategories.name: Temporal
subcategories.description: Use frame history to process thin lines and diagonals. Experimental methods can produce ghosting at moving edges.

zh-Hans.name: 锐化细节
zh-Hans.description: 增强边缘与局部对比，让偏软的画面更清楚。

subcategories.name: 通用锐化
subcategories.description: 通常在缩放后使用一种锐化，从较低强度开始；较强处理会放大噪声，并在高对比边缘产生光圈。

en-US.name: Sharpening
en-US.description: Enhance edges and local contrast to clarify soft images.

subcategories.name: General sharpening
subcategories.description: Usually apply one sharpener after resizing, starting at low strength. Stronger settings amplify noise and create halos at high-contrast edges.

zh-Hans.name: 补帧与帧率
zh-Hans.description: 补帧增加用于显示的中间画面，限帧控制基础输入频率。基础帧率、重复检测与空闲重绘在“帧率与刷新”中设置。

subcategories.name: 补帧
subcategories.description: 每个效果组选择一种补帧方案，从 2× 开始。较高倍率增加处理开销；快速运动、遮挡和游戏文字可能产生伪影。

subcategories.name: 帧率调度
subcategories.description: 设置捕获与处理的基础帧率上限；使用补帧时，以此作为生成帧的输入频率。

en-US.name: Frame generation and frame rate
en-US.description: Frame generation adds intermediate images for display; limiting controls the base input rate. Set the base rate, duplicate detection, and idle redraw in Frame rate and refresh.

subcategories.name: Frame generation
subcategories.description: Choose one frame generator per group and start at 2x. Higher multipliers cost more processing; fast motion, occlusion, and game text can produce artifacts.

subcategories.name: Frame-rate control
subcategories.description: Cap the base rate of capture and processing; with frame generation, this is the input rate used to generate frames.

zh-Hans.name: 风格显示
zh-Hans.description: 按观看偏好调整颜色、亮度、纹理或复古显示外观。

subcategories.name: CRT
subcategories.description: 用扫描线、遮罩、辉光或曲面模拟旧式屏幕，通常放在缩放后。外观按 SDR 设计，HDR 经过兼容转换。

subcategories.name: 图像调整
subcategories.description: 调整画面的明暗与颜色，从亮度、对比度开始逐项设置。

subcategories.name: AI 画面重塑
subcategories.description: 重新塑造纹理与细节风格，从单次、较低强度开始探索画面质感。

en-US.name: Display styles
en-US.description: Adjust color, brightness, textures, or retro display appearance to suit viewing preferences.

subcategories.name: CRT
subcategories.description: Simulate vintage screens with scanlines, masks, glow, or curvature, usually after resizing. The look is designed for SDR; HDR uses compatibility conversion.

subcategories.name: Image adjustment
subcategories.description: Adjust tone and color, starting with brightness and contrast one control at a time.

subcategories.name: AI image enhancement
subcategories.description: Reshape textures and detail style; start with one pass at low intensity to explore the look.

zh-Hans.name: 诊断调试
zh-Hans.description: 查看运动方向与估计置信度，定位时序处理问题。

subcategories.name: 诊断
subcategories.description: 用色图显示运动与可靠程度，适合调试光流和连续帧处理。

en-US.name: Diagnostics
en-US.description: Inspect motion direction and confidence to locate temporal-processing issues.

subcategories.name: Diagnostics
subcategories.description: Display motion and reliability as color maps for debugging optical flow and consecutive-frame processing.

zh-Hans.name: HDR 组件
zh-Hans.description: 设置 HDR／SDR 的转换顺序。兼容配对用于中间 SDR 处理，白点映射呈现 SDR 内容，TrueHDR 用 AI 重塑亮度与颜色；HDR 捕获或输出需对应屏幕开启 Windows HDR。

en-US.name: HDR components
en-US.description: Set HDR/SDR conversion order. Compatibility pairs allow an SDR processing section, white-point mapping presents SDR content, and TrueHDR uses AI to reshape brightness and color. Enable Windows HDR on the relevant capture/output display.

zh-Hans.name: Anime4K
zh-Hans.summary: 按放大、降噪或线条修复选择。S～UL 表示模型规模；Soft 修复较柔和，GAN 更主动地塑造纹理。

en-US.name: Anime4K
en-US.summary: Choose upscaling, denoising, or line restoration. S–UL indicate model size; Soft uses gentler restoration, while GAN shapes textures more actively.

zh-Hans.name: CAS
zh-Hans.summary: CAS 在原尺寸锐化，CAS Scaling 同时缩放与锐化；按是否需要改变尺寸选择。

en-US.name: CAS
en-US.summary: CAS sharpens at the input size; CAS Scaling resizes and sharpens together. Choose according to whether the image needs resizing.

zh-Hans.name: CuNNy
zh-Hans.summary: 动画与视觉小说的 2× 放大。原版 DN 同时降噪，CuNNy2 提供另一代模型；数字表示层数与通道数，较大模型需要更多计算。

en-US.name: CuNNy
en-US.summary: 2x upscaling for anime and visual novels. Original DN models also denoise; CuNNy2 offers another model generation. Numbers describe layers and channels; larger models need more computation.

zh-Hans.name: FSR
zh-Hans.summary: FSR 1 的空间处理：EASU 放大，RCAS 保持尺寸锐化。可按需要分别使用，也可先放大再锐化。

en-US.name: FSR
en-US.summary: FSR 1 spatial processing: EASU upscales and RCAS sharpens at the input size. Use either independently or upscale first, then sharpen.

zh-Hans.name: FSRCNNX
zh-Hans.summary: 固定 2× 神经网络放大。通用模型面向一般图像，LineArt 模型面向动画与线稿。

en-US.name: FSRCNNX
en-US.summary: Fixed 2x neural-network upscaling. The general model suits general images; LineArt targets anime and line art.

zh-Hans.name: FXAA
zh-Hans.summary: 当前帧的快速抗锯齿。Medium、High、Ultra 逐步增加边缘搜索量，可按处理余量选择。

en-US.name: FXAA
en-US.summary: Fast anti-aliasing of the current frame. Medium, High, and Ultra progressively increase edge searching; choose according to processing headroom.

zh-Hans.name: NIS
zh-Hans.summary: NIS 同时放大与锐化；NVSharpen 保持尺寸，只做锐化。按需要改变尺寸或收尾细节选择。

en-US.name: NIS
en-US.summary: NIS upscales and sharpens together; NVSharpen sharpens at the input size. Choose for resizing or finishing detail.

zh-Hans.name: NNEDI3
zh-Hans.summary: 固定 2× 神经插值，适合动画与线稿。nns 表示神经元数量，win 表示采样窗口；较大规格使用更多采样与计算。

en-US.name: NNEDI3
en-US.summary: Fixed 2x neural interpolation for anime and line art. nns is the neuron count and win the sampling window; larger settings use more samples and computation.

zh-Hans.name: RAVU
zh-Hans.summary: 普通／Lite 为 2×，3x 为 3×，Zoom 可设目标尺寸。R 表示采样规格；Lite 减少计算，AR 抑制边缘光圈，RGB 同时重建颜色通道。

en-US.name: RAVU
en-US.summary: Standard/Lite scale 2x, 3x scales 3x, and Zoom accepts a target size. R denotes sampling size; Lite reduces computation, AR suppresses edge rings, and RGB reconstructs color channels too.

zh-Hans.name: SMAA
zh-Hans.summary: Low～Ultra 对当前帧做边缘搜索；T2x／4x 结合帧历史。NoJitter 取消额外采样抖动并保留时序处理，适合希望保持采样位置稳定时尝试。

en-US.name: SMAA
en-US.summary: Low–Ultra search edges in the current frame; T2x/4x use frame history. NoJitter retains temporal processing while omitting added sampling jitter, for trying stable sampling positions.

zh-Hans.name: xBR
zh-Hans.summary: 平滑像素画轮廓。LV2 提供 2×～4×；NoBlend 3× 保留收到的 SDR 调色板；Hybrid 2× 处理已有抗锯齿的 SDR 素材，HDR 时采用最近邻放大。

en-US.name: xBR
en-US.summary: Smooth pixel-art outlines. LV2 offers 2x–4x; NoBlend 3x preserves the received SDR palette; Hybrid 2x targets anti-aliased SDR content and uses nearest-neighbor scaling in HDR.

zh-Hans.name: xBRZ
zh-Hans.summary: 平滑像素画的斜线与曲线。2×～6× 为固定倍率，Freescale 用于将画面适配到目标尺寸。

en-US.name: xBRZ
en-US.summary: Smooth diagonals and curves in pixel art. 2x–6x use fixed scales; Freescale fits the image to a target size.

zh-Hans.name: XeSS Frame Generation
zh-Hans.summary: 为连续画面生成 2×～4× 显示帧。可从默认 2×、AMD 光流开始；非 Intel 显卡的 3×／4× 使用本项目实验兼容路径。

en-US.name: XeSS Frame Generation
en-US.summary: Generate display frames at 2x–4x. Start with the default 2x and AMD optical flow; 3x/4x on non-Intel GPUs uses this project’s experimental compatibility path.

zh-Hans.name: CuNNy 原版
zh-Hans.summary: 原版 2× 模型。普通版重建线条，DN 同时降噪；层数和通道数共同决定模型规模。

en-US.name: CuNNy original
en-US.summary: Original 2x models. Standard variants reconstruct outlines; DN also denoises. Layer and channel counts determine model size.

zh-Hans.name: CuNNy2
zh-Hans.summary: CuNNy2 的 2× 模型。fast 系列侧重减少计算，数字型号按层数与通道数提供不同规模。

en-US.name: CuNNy2
en-US.summary: CuNNy2 models at 2x. The fast series focuses on less computation; numbered variants offer different layer and channel counts.

en-US.summary: Expand SDR into HDR using NVIDIA AI.
en-US.details:
Keeps the input size, after the SDR effects section; convert HDR input through HDR → SDR first. AI reshapes brightness and color rather than restoring the original HDR.

Requires a supported NVIDIA RTX GPU, driver, and bundled RTX Video HDR runtime, with Windows HDR enabled on the output display. Set peak brightness for the display, then compare contrast, saturation, and middle gray. All four parameters update live; cost depends on resolution and GPU.

issueDefinitions.long-or-technical-product-copy: Replace repeated compilation requirements, implementation detail, and historical-review prose with purpose, variants, placement, sizes, and necessary constraints.
issueDefinitions.bilingual-terminology-and-scope: Author matching current guidance in both languages; jitter means sampling offset, not camera shake.
issueDefinitions.recommendation-confused-cost-with-maturi: Separate processing cost from integration maturity and choose tags by scenario and setup complexity.
issueDefinitions.missing-serial-passes: Describe 1–3 serial DLSSNR passes with independent per-pass settings.
issueDefinitions.detail-controls-activation: SDR detail controls need input-resolution adjustment and apply once to the final total change.
issueDefinitions.unverified-driver-and-gpu-list: Do not present the historical user-supplied compatibility list as an officially verified universal requirement.
issueDefinitions.single-vs-multipass-failure: Single-pass creation can fall back to passthrough; multipass failure rejects creation.
issueDefinitions.unified-frame-refresh-guidance: Use the unified Frame rate and refresh entry; distinguish base FPS from displayed FPS.
issueDefinitions.family-training-difference-not-network-s: General and LineArt use different trained weights in the installed variants.
issueDefinitions.jitter-is-sampling-offset-not-camera-sha: NoJitter still uses frame history; only the additional sampling shift is removed.
